[LSER.6.9.5] The disambiguation in [LSER.6.9] is orthogonal
to the within-slot label mechanism in [LSER.6.8]. Both can
apply: a schema with two slots each having multiple labelled
time-model lines resolves first by slot ([LSER.6.9.2]–
[LSER.6.9.3]), then by label within that slot's series
([LSER.6.8.1]–[LSER.6.8.5]).
